notes.title: Next? Slitherine
notes.notes:
[b]Slitherine Next[/b], the spiritual successor of our Home of Wargamers events, is coming soon.
Save the date: [b]December 13th at 4 pm GMT[/b] on [url=https://www.twitch.tv/slitherinetv/schedule?segmentID=4b0d1a22-f043-4b2c-bea9-4432b0a770bb]Twitch[/url]

It'll be the perfect occasion to learn more about upcoming games and get an insight directly from the developers. 

It will be [b]100% live[/b]: there will be no pre-recorded segments and we'll have a level of interaction with the players like never before. You'll be able to ask us anything and be answered directly by the developers.

Stay tuned for the full schedule!

notes.title: The Flare Path: Unstitched
notes.notes: Crisis! Geoff, the retired sailmaker who usually stitches together FP news stories, phoned in sick this morning (housemaid’s knee). We’ve experimented with alternative fastenings – velcro, staples, bulldog clips, ant-head sutures… – but none of them are strong and flexible enough to join this week’s selection of topical sim and strategy snippets. Unless Irma’s ongoing porridge experiments prove successful, I fear today’s column will have to take the form of an index finger inconveniencing gallery. … [visit site to read more]

notes.title: Qvadriga is in a weekly Humble Bundle!
notes.notes:
What have the Middle Ages, the Second World War, Ancient Rome and Hellish demons got in common?

Probably nothing, apart from the fact they are the settings of our games in the [url=https://www.humblebundle.com/weekly]Weekly Humble Bundle![/url]

Starting today a huge list of Slitherine/Matrix games will be available through the Humble section.

You can [b]name your price for Conquest! Medieval Realms, Frontline: Road to Moscow, Battle Academy, and Rise of Prussia Gold.[/b]

If you wish, you can pay [b]$6 or more to receive Qvadriga and Hell[/b] as well.

And last but not least, [b]for only $10 or more you will receive all of the above plus Close Combat: Gateway to Caen,[/b] the latest release in the critically-acclaimed Close Combat series!

Don’t miss the opportunity to play these amazing games and help a charity at the same time!

notes.title: The Bestest Best Racing Game Of 2014: Qvadriga
notes.notes:
In what other racing game might your three horsepower engine collapse from over-zealous whipping? Qvadriga is a historical chariot simulator that spins stories of bloody rivalries and daring comebacks alongside its quickly spinning wheels, and that’s why we love it.

Adam: Of course our favourite racing game of the year is turn-based. Of COURSE it is.

notes.title: The Cost Of War(gaming): Matrix Games Sale
notes.notes:
In a world where it’s increasingly likely that game bundles will soon be given away with Happy Meals, people are often flabbered right down to the gasts when they see the prices over on planet Matrix. The wargaming/strategy publisher doesn’t discount its back catalogue as often as some companies discount their front catalogue, so when the annual holiday sale rolls around, it’s worth paying attention to. Lots of titles are discounted by 50%, including the excellent Unity of Command and its expansions. The Gary Grigsby titles are also on sale, as are many others, listed here.
